question: “PM POSHAN” Scheme is implemented by which ministry?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Ministry of Education.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Pradhan Mantri Poshan Shakti Nirman:-**

__
 
• **The PM POSHAN Scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Education. **
 
• It is a centrally sponsored scheme that provides one hot cooked meal to children in government and government-aided schools from pre-primary to class VIII.
 
• The scheme was launched in 2021-22 and is currently in its third year of implementation.
 
• The two main objectives of the PM POSHAN scheme are to:
 
 
• **Improve the nutritional status of children in Government and Government-aided schools from Class 1 to 8.**
 
• **Encourage poor children, especially those from disadvantaged sections, to attend school and help them concentrate on classroom activities.**
 
 
 
• Some of the benefits of the PM POSHAN scheme are as follows:-
 
 
• **It helps to improve the nutritional status of children.**
 
• **It encourages children to attend school and helps them concentrate on classroom activities.**
 
• **It improves the health and development of children.**
 
• **It enhances the future opportunities of children.**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of Women and Child Development (WCD):-**

 
 
• It is the apex body in the Government of India for formulation and administration of the rules and regulations and laws relating to women and child development in India. 
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment:-**
 
 
• MSJE is a Government of India ministry responsible for the welfare, social justice, and empowerment of disadvantaged and marginalized sections of society.
 
• The ministry was established in 1999 with the merger of the Ministry of Welfare and the Department of Social Justice and Empowerment.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Women and Child Development:-**
 
 
• WCD is a branch of the Government of India that is responsible for the development and empowerment of women and children, and for ensuring their protection from all forms of violence and exploitation.
